messages:
katie: Planning to flip feature flag `kv_prefetch_v2` -> ENABLE (20% traffic) in us-west at 22:00 UTC today. Low-priority tenants first. Need: flip owner, smoke checker, rollback watcher. Window ~30m.

devon: I can own the flip and watch the first 15m. I’ll be on-call and at my laptop.

sara: I’ll do the smoke checklist and post results here. What’s the exact API call to enable the flag?

katie: Use the admin toggle endpoint (example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/admin/flags 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"kv_prefetch_v2": {"state":"enabled","pct":20,"scope":"us-west"}}'
```
Checklist I’ll run: 1) healthchecks for canaries, 2) 95/99 latency sample for affected endpoints, 3) prefix cache hitrate in Grafana (dashboard: prefix_cache_v2), 4) check logs for new WARN/ERRORs.

lee: Quick Q — rollback policy? If we see >1% 5xx or tail latency +30% we rollback immediately, correct? Also where’s the kill-switch?

katie: Correct — hard threshold is 1% 5xx or sustained +30% p95 for 5 minutes. Kill-switch options:
- admin toggle back to disabled (same endpoint, pct=0)
- ops bot command: `deploy-bot rollback kv_prefetch_v2` (preferred for speed)

ton y: I’ll be the rollback watcher. If I see anomalies I’ll run `deploy-bot rollback` and post timestamp + reason.

deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle job created for 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z by katie. Preflight checks OK (schema, auth).

sara: Starting smoke run at 22:02 UTC. Running: curl /health for canary-1, canary-2; sampling latency via /metrics?tenant=canary-*.

devon: Flipping now — 22:03 UTC. API returned 200. Set `kv_prefetch_v2` to enabled @20% in us-west.

katie: Confirmed flip seen in dashboard at 22:04 UTC. Monitoring: no error spike so far. Please post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:

lee: Observability check (22:07): p95 +4%, 5xx steady at 0.2%, cache hitrate improved ~6% on canaries. All green so far.

sara: Smoke complete (22:10): health = OK, no error logs, latency within expected. I’ll hold on an extended watch for 20m and report.

ton y: If anything goes wrong — call it out and I’ll run rollback. Otherwise we can consider bumping to 50% at 22:30 after an OK pass.

katie: Thanks everyone. Plan: keep at 20% until 22:30, then discuss bump. Devon remains flip owner; Sara smoke checker; Tony rollback watcher. Thread closed unless we see issues.
